title: Underground Waterway
paragraphs: …Just as I was about to sleep, I remembered something.
“I’ll go get some fresh night air.”
“Hm? Oh, okay.”

There was something I had to do before going to bed. If my guess was right, something was bound to happen soon. I casually left the room, stepped outside the inn… and used the portal to move. Yes, I had a feeling that something would happen tonight. I used the portal to return to Melromarc Castle.

It was already nighttime at Melromarc Castle. The guards were patrolling the area. As for any attempts to attack the Queen… nothing yet, it seems. There’s always a concern about that, but since there are still loyalists to the Queen, it should be fine.

I moved stealthily through the castle, using concealment skills and magic to stay hidden. Then, I made my way to a certain location. There are only so many places in Melromarc Castle where someone like him could be held. Let’s just call this a precautionary surveillance.
And sure enough, it didn’t take long for them to show up. Even I was dumbfounded that they actually dared to come out.
“Buu-buu!”
“Damn it! Damn it, damn it, damn it! Those fake heroes…!”

A pig and… smoked meat, I see. That group was now packing up, trying to escape with the guards they had bribed. The guards on watch must have been bought off. The pigs had left the detention tower and were now rushing toward the underground prison.

Just as I expected. After their schemes had failed and the situation didn’t turn out the way they wanted, I figured the pigs would try to escape tonight. After all, under the Queen’s supervision, with no one left to protect them, and with the scum who tolerated their selfishness stripped of power and uncertain if they would ever regain it, there was no way the pigs would sit still.
The Queen is too lenient sometimes. If she had just bound them with a high-level slave crest, they wouldn’t be attempting to escape so easily.
“Bubu! Bububu!”

The pig was giving orders to Smoked Meat and the soldiers under its command, directing them toward the escape route beyond the underground prison. They’re using the same route as before. They must have realized that escaping from the front was impossible.

Maybe I should have just kept watch here instead? As I pondered this, the pigs and their group moved from the underground prison toward the waterway. Once the time was right, I moved in behind them. As a little experiment, I used the Soul Eater Spear’s skill to pierce the pig. I gripped the spear tightly and drove its sharp tip straight into the pig’s back.
“Buhii!?”
The pig let out a squeal, froze for a moment, and then fell to its knees. I slowly revealed myself.
“P-Princess?”

Smoked Meat and the soldiers turned toward the pig, who had suddenly stopped… and then turned pale when they saw me. Hahaha, they must not have expected me to show up. They looked like they had just encountered a monster.
“Where do you think you’re going?”
“Y-You’re…!”
Smoked Meat pointed at me with a pale face. Well, that’s expected. He always sides with the stronger party, so this reaction makes sense. More importantly, the pig.
“B-Bububu, buhi!”

I had pierced it with the Soul Eater Spear, so its soul was already slipping out. The pig’s soul, impaled on the tip of my spear, was groaning while hanging in midair. Still lively, it seems. Even while being skewered, it was desperately resisting.
“Buhibububu!? Buhi!”
It was squealing about something, but I couldn’t understand a word. Not that I care to understand.
“You were probably planning something shallow, like escaping from a country where you’re no longer welcome and plotting revenge on us. But that won’t happen.”
“Buhi!?”
The pig’s spirit looked at me with a shocked expression. As I thought. This pig’s actions are so predictable. Though I can imagine a few other scenarios it might have considered.
“Were you planning to ally with the Three Heroes Church to overthrow the Queen? Or perhaps flee to Faubrey and rely on Takt?”
It was even more shocked now. This is starting to get boring. Oh? Smoked Meat has collapsed in fear after seeing me. The morning’s impalement must have left quite the impression.
“Bububu—”
“I have no intention of negotiating with you. This morning, I held back because of Father, Trash, and the Queen. But pig… I have no intention of letting you slip away again.”

Yes… you’re the one who killed Freon-chan, and you’re nothing more than a stepping stone to prove myself to Father and the others. You have no value left. Before you cause any more trouble, I’ll erase you from this world. Your soul, that is.
“Now then, disappear! Burst Lance X!”
“Buhi—!?”
With the maximum output of Burst Lance, I annihilated the pig’s soul. What filthy particles.
“Now then…”
I twirled my spear lightly, changing its shape. Smoked Meat, still collapsed, and the soldiers, who were ready to fight, glared at me.
“If I let you escape here, my plan will be exposed. Witnesses must all be eliminated.”

Yes, this is the plan to erase the pig from this world before it can cause any more trouble. No matter how rotten it is, it’s still a princess. If I dispose of it publicly, it could create friction with the Queen. The Queen herself would probably let it go, but Father and the others might become more cautious of me.
“Hi-hiii! I-I’m on the side of the heroes! Please, spare me—!”
Smoked Meat was begging for its life. But I don’t care. Being here today sealed your fate. If you had just holed up in your own territory, you could have lived longer…
“I don’t listen to pleas. Now, die together! Brionac X!”
“Wha—”
“St-stop, waaaah—!”
I unleashed the attack on Smoked Meat and the soldiers without damaging the underground waterway. I wiped them out completely, leaving no trace. Should I dispose of their souls just to be safe?

As I was pondering that, I noticed a faint light drifting from the depths of the underground waterway. What is that? If I recall correctly, ghost-type monsters appear in the underground waterways of Melromarc. Most likely, they’re drawn by the souls of Smoked Meat and the soldiers I just took down.
But more importantly, the experiment results. I checked on the pig, who had collapsed to its knees, staring blankly with its soul extracted.

The pig was still dazed, staring off in the direction it had been looking when it was stabbed, its gaze unfocused. This means its soul had already left. This reaction was completely different from when I defeated the pig that had been possessed last time. The experiment results are in. The pig wasn’t someone who had been possessed and corrupted into its current form, as Father and the others suspected.
It was rotten from the start! Well, I’ll leave the leftovers alive.
“Now then, time to withdraw.”

I stowed my spear, left the pig there, and escaped through the underground waterway. I returned to Father and the others in Zeltoble as if nothing had happened. Incidentally, a few days later, the tracking unit dispatched to chase down the escaped pig found it sitting blankly in the underground waterway.

The official story was that the escaped pig had been attacked by some evil spirit dwelling in the underground waterway and was reduced to a vegetable out of sheer terror. This means there’s a little less filth in this world.
Hahaha!
The next morning. When I took Father and the others to the castle, the Queen came out to greet us. We were scheduled to have an audience in the throne room and discuss future plans.
“Good morning, Four Holy Heroes.”
“Ah, yes. Good morning.”

Father and the others each returned the greeting. Just then, the door behind us burst open with a loud bang. Turning around, I saw the scum standing there, breathing heavily, glaring at us with a furious expression. Oh? Did he break out of confinement? It seems the Queen’s encirclement is still incomplete, considering the pig managed to escape. Well, it can’t be helped since the Queen only returned yesterday.
“You…! You did this, didn’t you?! I won’t forgive you! I’ll never forgive youuuuu!”
“Huh?”
The scum clenched his fist and charged toward us, ready to strike. The Queen raised her hand and ordered the soldiers to restrain him. The sister and her friend, frightened, hid behind Father.
